page.layout: One blank page: no printed text. Only a dark ink device (a lion rampant in a shield, probably a stamp or ownership mark) near the centre, a faint circular mark at the top, and show-through from the other side.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. The dark centred device (a lion rampant holding a shield) looks like a library or owner's stamp rather than printer's matter, so it is not transcribed. Faint brownish marks at the top right edge belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. Faint grey marks on the left and in the lower centre are show-through, not text. The scan is of blank vellum-backed paper, with tape or a paper strip on the right edge.
